Pattern for naming image sequence files. Supports `[frame]` for the zero-padded frame number and `[ext]` for the file extension.

## CLI flag

```text
--image-sequence-pattern <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#imagesequencepattern-)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setImageSequencePattern('frame_[frame]_custom.[ext]');
```
